description:
The software update status summary.

TIP: Gets a summary of Windows update statuses across managed devices. Returns counts by status: compliantDeviceCount, nonCompliantDeviceCount, remediatedDeviceCount, errorDeviceCount, conflictDeviceCount, unknownDeviceCount, notApplicableDeviceCount.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-software-update-summary
